approvalText: Approve the five ME-25 relationships and their identified clinical sources for local-only, fail-closed implementation against the current authoritative registry state; all five sources enter verified:false / pending-verification, with no citation promotion, semantic broadening, taxonomy change, or remote writes.

rows.publicationGuard: Require documented acanthosis nigricans, independently established type 2 diabetes, compatible metabolic phenotype/chronology, and competing-cause review; do not infer diabetes from a skin finding alone.
Require documented wet-beriberi/thiamine-deficiency phenotype, objective heart failure, compatible chronology, and competing-cause review; do not infer heart failure from beriberi alone.
Require documented ASD anatomy, objective pulmonary hypertension, compatible shunt/chronology, and competing-cause review; do not infer pulmonary hypertension from an ASD label alone.
Require documented avian-antigen hypersensitivity-pneumonitis phenotype, objective fibrosis, compatible chronology, and alternative-cause review; do not infer fibrosis from exposure or dyspnea alone.
Require documented atrophic glossitis, objective anemia subtype and hematinic findings, compatible chronology, and competing-cause review; do not infer anemia from tongue appearance alone.
